external_primary_evidence.relevant_fact: ARC-AGI-3 defines an action as a discrete environment interaction and explicitly excludes internal tool calls, reasoning steps and retries from action count.
Competition mode constrains external environment interaction and reset/open behavior, reinforcing that the benchmark's counted resource is the environment-action channel.

observed_f2_gap.current_capability_evidence: CapabilityEvidence stores one action_count plus performance/baseline scores, receipt/reconciliation identities and held-out identifiers.
observed_f2_gap.current_policy: FalsifierPolicy gates intervention score, delta over baseline, sample count and shared holdout set; it has no external-action ceiling/ratio and no internal-compute envelope.
observed_f2_gap.current_evaluator: evaluate_agentic_core sums action_count into total_action_count but does not use total or per-capability action count to determine SUPPORTED_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE versus FALSIFIED.

architecture_conclusion: WP807 currently falsifies four-capability outcome quality under a matched held-out policy, but it does not yet falsify the 'efficient' part of a general agentic-core claim. External interaction efficiency and internal compute efficiency must remain separate, explicitly measured axes.

proposed_minimal_delta.do_not_import: Do not import ARC scoring or duck-harness runtime as authority/dependency.
capability_evidence_v2: replace ambiguous single action_count with baseline_action_count and intervention_action_count or add an exact matched baseline action identity
bind compute_profile_id + compute_profile_sha256 so model/runtime/tokenizer measurement semantics cannot drift between baseline and intervention
retain latency/RSS/GPU/I/O as characterization fields where measured, not silently promoted into deterministic semantic truth
policy_v2: freeze an external-action efficiency gate before aggregate results are observed
freeze internal model-call/token/tool-call envelopes or matched-baseline ratios before aggregate results are observed
fail closed on missing or mismatched compute-profile identity when claiming efficiency
do not collapse outcome quality, external action efficiency and internal compute efficiency into one scalar acceptance authority
report_v2: retain all runtime/GRID10/GWT/effect/completion/whole-system credits at zero at repository component scope

counterhypotheses.statement: Existing intervention_score_ppm already includes all relevant efficiency semantics, so explicit compute evidence is redundant.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Trace the producer contract for each WP802-WP805 intervention score. If every score is provably bound to a frozen resource-equivalent protocol including internal compute and external actions, this delta can be reduced or retired. Without that binding, score_ppm cannot be assumed to encode hidden compute cost.

counterhypotheses.statement: Internal compute should be deliberately unconstrained because only world actions matter.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Run matched held-out capability tests where two systems have equal completion/action counts but one uses materially more model calls/tokens/tool compute. If F2's product criterion treats them as equally efficient, no internal gate is needed; otherwise the current WP807 contract is under-specified.

nonduplicate_boundary.this_delta_scope: internal compute cost versus external action efficiency only
nonduplicate_boundary.trigger4_mutation_lane: Existing WP807 Trigger-4 owner remains the only build/mutation lane; this Trigger-6 delta does not modify src/tests or claim build completion.

acceptance_gate_for_next_stage: Trigger-4 or the sole WP807 mutation owner must bind a frozen V2 efficiency policy and executable fail-closed tests showing that missing compute identity, excessive external actions, or excessive internal compute cannot yield SUPPORTED_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE. Then compare matched baseline/intervention on the same held-out family and compute profile.
